text:
This week: new image models, GIFs, editable SVGs, and video joined the catalog. Play now keeps runs and separate media drafts during the same visit. It also gained recording and a Decide workspace. New text, speech, realtime, and decision models landed too. Connect sign-in works without an App Key (PKCE is still required). Repeat Quest rewards collect on one card, MCP gained more tools, and 26 community apps joined the catalog. Browse at https://pollinations.ai 🐝
